scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@prossh/rules && npm run build --workspace=@prossh/client && npm run build --workspace=@prossh/match-server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@prossh/rules && npm run test:simulator && npm run rules:test:oracle
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace=@prossh/rules && npm run check --workspace=@prossh/rules && npm run check --workspace=@prossh/client && npm run check --workspace=@prossh/match-server
scripts.rules:oracle:compile: python tools/rules/compile_oracle_effects.py --catalog data/catalog/prossh.sqlite --output data/rules/oracle-effects.json --prompt-output data/rules/oracle-review.md --cluster-output data/rules/oracle-clusters.json --cache-output data/rules/oracle-card-cache.json
scripts.rules:oracle:c13: python tools/rules/compile_oracle_effects.py --catalog data/catalog/prossh.sqlite --set-code c13 --output data/rules/oracle-effects-c13.json --prompt-output data/rules/oracle-review-c13.md --cluster-output data/rules/oracle-clusters-c13.json --cache-output data/rules/oracle-card-cache-c13.json
scripts.rules:roadmap:c13: python tools/rules/plan_primitive_roadmap.py --profiles data/rules/engine-card-profiles.json --decks data/decks/commander-precons.json --set-code C13 --output data/rules/primitive-roadmap-c13.json --prompt-output docs/PRIMITIVE_ROADMAP_C13.md --claim-prefix c13 --top 40
scripts.rules:workers: python tools/rules/plan_primitive_workers.py --roadmap data/rules/primitive-roadmap.json --claims docs/WORK_CLAIMS.md --output data/rules/primitive-worker-plan.json --prompt-output docs/PRIMITIVE_WORKERS.md --workers 5 --memory-budget-gb 2
